tex_content.html:
Definition
[ray, line]

Source: petersen:page-0313 A ray $r:[0,\infty )\to (M,g)$ is a unit-speed geodesic with $|r(t)r(s)|=|t-s|$ for all $t,s\ge 0$; it may be viewed as a semi-infinite segment, or a segment from $r(0)$ to infinity. A line $l:\mathbb {R}\to (M,g)$ is a unit-speed geodesic with $|l(t)l(s)|=|t-s|$ for all $t,s\in \mathbb {R}$.
